blocks.text: Acompáñennos este domingo
blocks.back: Accompany us this Sunday

blocks.text: Todos son bienvenidos en Grace Fellowship este domingo, 15 de noviembre. Nuestro culto comienza a las 10:30 AM en 250 Grace Lane.
blocks.back: All are welcome at Grace Fellowship this Sunday, 15 of November. Our worship begins at the 10:30 AM in 250 Grace Lane.

blocks.text: El registro de niños abre a las 10:15 AM en la Sala Familiar. Traiga a su niño a la recepción y le daremos una etiqueta con el mismo nombre.
blocks.back: The registration of children opens at the 10:15 AM in the Family Room. Bring to your child to the reception and we will give to you a tag with the same name.

blocks.text: El estacionamiento gratis está detrás del edificio. ¿Preguntas? Llame al (239) 555-0142 o envíe un correo a hello@gracefellowship.example.
blocks.back: The free parking is behind the building. Questions? Call to the (239) 555-0142 or send an email to hello@gracefellowship.example.

blocks.text: Este mensaje fue traducido con ayuda de IA y revisado por un voluntario de nuestra iglesia.
blocks.back: This message was translated with help of AI and reviewed by a volunteer of our church.

blocks.text: 欢迎您本周日来参加
blocks.back: Welcome you this Sunday come participate

blocks.text: 大家都欢迎在 Grace Fellowship 于 11 月 15 日周日参加。我们的 崇拜 上午 10:30 在 250 Grace Lane 开始。
blocks.back: Everyone all welcome at Grace Fellowship on 11 month 15 day Sunday participate. Our worship morning 10:30 at 250 Grace Lane begins.

blocks.text: 儿童签到 于上午 10:15 在家庭室开始。请带孩子到前台，我们会给您一张配对的名牌。
blocks.back: Children check-in at morning 10:15 at family room begins. Please bring children to front desk, we will give you a piece of matching name tag.

blocks.text: 免费停车场在楼后。有问题？请拨打 (239) 555-0142 或发邮件至 hello@gracefellowship.example。
blocks.back: Free parking lot at building rear. Have questions? Please dial (239) 555-0142 or send email to hello@gracefellowship.example.

blocks.text: 本信息由 AI 协助翻译，并由我们教会的一位 志愿者 核对。
blocks.back: This information by AI assisted translation, and by our church's a volunteer verified.

blocks.text: Vini ak nou dimanch sa a
blocks.back: Come with us this Sunday

blocks.text: Tout moun byenveni nan Grace Fellowship dimanch sa a, November 15. Sèvis adorasyon nou an kòmanse a 10:30 AM nan 250 Grace Lane.
blocks.back: Everyone welcome at Grace Fellowship this Sunday, November 15. Our worship service starts at 10:30 AM at 250 Grace Lane.

blocks.text: Enskripsyon timoun yo ouvri a 10:15 AM nan Family Room. Mennen pitit ou nan biwo devan e nou pral ba ou yon mak etik non ki koresponn.
blocks.back: Children's registration opens at 10:15 AM in the Family Room. Take your child to the front office and we will give you a corresponding name tag.

blocks.text: Pak gratis la nan dèyè bilding la. Ou gen kesyon? Rele (239) 555-0142 oswa imèl hello@gracefellowship.example.
blocks.back: Free parking is in the back of the building. You have questions? Call (239) 555-0142 or email hello@gracefellowship.example.

blocks.text: Mesaj sa a te tradwi ak èd AI e tcheke pa yon volontè nan legliz nou an.
blocks.back: This message was translated with the help of AI and checked by a volunteer in our church.

blocks.text: Hãy cùng chúng tôi vào Chủ Nhật này
blocks.back: Let's together us into this Sunday

blocks.text: Mọi người đều được chào đón tại Grace Fellowship vào Chủ Nhật này, November 15. Buổi thờ phượng của chúng tôi bắt đầu lúc 10:30 AM tại 250 Grace Lane.
blocks.back: Everyone is welcomed at Grace Fellowship this Sunday, November 15. Our worship service starts at 10:30 AM at 250 Grace Lane.

blocks.text: Đăng ký trẻ em mở lúc 10:15 AM tại Family Room. Hãy đưa con đến quầy tiếp tân và chúng tôi sẽ trao cho bạn một thẻ tên trùng khớp.
blocks.back: Children registration opens at 10:15 AM at Family Room. Please bring child to reception desk and we will give you a matching name tag.

blocks.text: Bãi đỗ xe miễn phí nằm phía sau tòa nhà. Có thắc mắc? Gọi (239) 555-0142 hoặc gửi email đến hello@gracefellowship.example.
blocks.back: Free parking lot lies behind building. Have questions? Call (239) 555-0142 or send email to hello@gracefellowship.example.

blocks.text: Tin nhắn này đã được dịch bằng sự hỗ trợ của AI và được kiểm tra bởi một tình nguyện viên từ nhà thờ của chúng tôi.
blocks.back: This message has been translated with AI support and checked by a volunteer from our church.

blocks.text: Comida de Acción de Gracias gratis para la comunidad
blocks.back: Free Thanksgiving meal for the community

blocks.text: El jueves 26 de noviembre, Grace Fellowship servirá una comida de Acción de Gracias gratis de 12:00 PM a 2:00 PM. Todos en el vecindario están invitados, y a nadie le pedirán que firme nada.
blocks.back: On Thursday November 26, Grace Fellowship will serve a free Thanksgiving meal from 12:00 PM to 2:00 PM. Everyone in the neighborhood is invited, and no one will be asked to sign anything.

blocks.text: Nuestra despensa de alimentos está abierta todos los martes de 4 PM a 6 PM. Cada familia puede llevarse una caja de víveres, como 20 libras.
blocks.back: Our food pantry is open every Tuesday from 4 PM to 6 PM. Each family can take a box of groceries, like 20 pounds.

blocks.text: Necesitamos 15 voluntarios para ayudar a servir. Regístrate en gracefellowship.example/meal.
blocks.back: We need 15 volunteers to help serve. Register at gracefellowship.example/meal.

blocks.text: Este mensaje fue traducido con ayuda de IA y revisado por un voluntario de nuestra iglesia.
blocks.back: This message was translated with help from AI and reviewed by a volunteer from our church.

blocks.text: 免费社区感恩节大餐
blocks.back: Free Community Thanksgiving Feast

blocks.text: 11月26日星期四，Grace Fellowship将从中午12:00到下午2:00提供免费感恩节大餐。欢迎邻里所有人参加，无需签署任何文件。
blocks.back: November 26 Thursday, Grace Fellowship will from noon 12:00 to afternoon 2:00 provide free Thanksgiving feast. Welcome neighborhood all people participate, no need sign any documents.

blocks.text: 我们的食物银行每周二下午4:00到6:00开放。每户家庭可领取一箱食品，约20磅。
blocks.back: Our food bank every Tuesday afternoon 4:00 to 6:00 open. Each household can receive one box food, about 20 pounds.

blocks.text: 我们需要15名志愿者帮忙分发。请在 gracefellowship.example/meal 报名。
blocks.back: We need 15 volunteers help distribute. Please at gracefellowship.example/meal sign up.

blocks.text: 本消息由AI协助翻译，并由教会的一名志愿者核对。
blocks.back: This message by AI assist translate, and by church's one volunteer verify.

blocks.text: Clase de inglés y grupos pequeños
blocks.back: English class and small groups

blocks.text: Clase gratuita de conversación en inglés todos los miércoles a las 6:30 PM. Las clases son para adultos de todos los niveles, y se ofrece cuidado de niños.
blocks.back: Free English conversation class every Wednesday at 6:30 PM. The classes are for adults of all levels, and childcare is offered.

blocks.text: Los grupos pequeños se reúnen en casas el viernes a las 7 PM. Un grupo pequeño es un lugar para compartir una comida, leer la Biblia juntos y orar los unos por los otros.
blocks.back: The small groups meet in houses on Friday at 7 PM. A small group is a place to share a meal, read the Bible together and pray for one another.

blocks.text: La Santa Cena se ofrece en cada culto del domingo. Si tienes preguntas al respecto, un pastor estará feliz de hablar contigo después del culto.
blocks.back: The Holy Supper is offered in every Sunday service. If you have questions about it, a pastor will be happy to speak with you after the service.

blocks.text: Este mensaje fue traducido con ayuda de IA y revisado por un voluntario de nuestra iglesia.
blocks.back: This message was translated with the help of AI and reviewed by a volunteer from our church.

blocks.text: Английский класс и малые группы
blocks.back: English class and small groups

blocks.text: Бесплатный разговорный клуб по английскому каждый среду в 6:30 вечера. Занятия для взрослых любого уровня, и предоставляется присмотр за детьми.
blocks.back: Free English conversation club every Wednesday at 6:30 evening. Classes for adults of any level, and supervision for children is provided.

blocks.text: Малые группы встречаются в домах в пятницу в 7 вечера. Малая группа, это место, где можно поделиться едой, вместе прочитать Библию и помолиться друг за друга.
blocks.back: Small groups meet in homes on Friday at 7 evening. Small group, this is a place where one can share food, together read the Bible and pray for each other.

blocks.text: Причастие предлагается на каждом воскресном богослужении. Если у вас есть вопросы, пастор с радостью поговорит с вами после службы.
blocks.back: Communion is offered at every Sunday service. If you have questions, the pastor will gladly talk with you after the service.

blocks.text: Это сообщение переведено с помощью ИИ и проверено волонтером нашей церкви.
